name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(key_lost), hard, matches the task. key_lost is the key dropped while the door is closed, so Absence forbids exactly that. A drop after the door opens leaves key_lost false, which matches 'while the door is still closed'. The task is a pure restriction with no commanded goal, so the rule-only machine with no final state is correct.

texts: Do not drop the key while the door is still closed.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost, u1) -> -10
